records.real_world_identity_notes: The PMR telemetry name S7R resolves to the Saleen S7-R, specifically the 2004 car named by PMR. The exact 2004 evidence describes the later sequential S7-R/EVO configuration. This is kept separate from the existing saleen-s7-r-gt1 record, whose identity is explicitly the distinct 2005 second-series GT1 representation. Early 2001 H-pattern/clutch instructions and later 2010 Xtrac data are retained as family or adjacent-variant evidence, not silently promoted to every 2004 car.

records.specification_basis: The exact 2004 S7-R EVO account states six speeds; the later technical listing independently describes the S7-R family as six-speed. The exact 2004 source calls the gearbox sequential with six speeds. The later technical source and Johnny Mowlem's revision history corroborate that the later S7-R family used sequential gearboxes. The exact 2004 source explicitly calls the gearbox sequential, and the driver interview separates the later sequential version from the early H-pattern version. Manual blip is a downshift action in this controls model; no upshift blip claim is being asserted. Automatic blip is a downshift action in this controls model; no upshift blip claim is being asserted. Throttle lift is represented as an upshift action in this controls model; no separate downshift-lift claim is asserted. Automatic cut is represented as an upshift action in this controls model; no downshift cut claim is asserted. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/transmission/shift_actuation, /authentic_controls/transmission/standing_start_clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/manual_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_blip, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shape, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/open_top, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/integrated_display, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shift_lights.
